title: List Operations (4 Stages)
description:
Practice working with lists across 4 stages:
1. Create list items = ["pen", "book"] and print items[0].
2. Append "pencil" to items and print len(items).
3. Pop the last item from items with items.pop() and print items.
4. Print the last item using negative index items[-1].
